body.description: The triage comment in Markdown: size with rationale, design decision, key files, risks. Without the '## Relay' heading and without a footer.

size.description: S: one or two files, under an hour of work. M: a few files, one sitting. L: touches several areas or needs a design decision first.

needs_design.description: true when the task changes what the user sees and the project's design config is 'auto' or 'always'.

key_files.description: Repository-relative paths that exist and that the plan stage should read first.
